MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB hub fits my ongoing desk setup because it could connect my keyboard and other low-bandwidth peripherals, with individual switches making them easier to manage.",
    "The microSD card connects naturally to my Raspberry Pi purchases and previous memory-card use; I could use a spare for another project after checking compatibility."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks and universal remote assume I am expanding a TV setup, while my latest purchases focus on wired networking, computer maintenance, and desk organization.",
    "Portable speakers do not serve the same purpose as my headphones and under-desk headphone holder; those purchases support personal listening at my desk.",
    "The USB-B cable has a familiar connection type, but I have no identified printer or external-drive connection that needs it. The smart display and doorbell likewise introduce needs I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in streaming, smart-home devices, and portable audio.",
    "Earlier HDMI and audio purchases seem to have been treated as continuing entertainment-shopping goals, despite my more recent emphasis on practical computer accessories."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, Ethernet cables, headphone mount, and electric duster together suggest that I am connecting, organizing, and maintaining an existing computer setup.",
    "A useful accessory needs a specific role and compatible connections. The hub and spare microSD card have plausible uses in my setup, while a long USB-B cable does not yet have one."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in computer accessories but stretched it too broadly into entertainment and smart-home shopping."
}
